incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTO-PAGE fired: PROD edge TLS handshakes failing (high rate) — service: edge-proxy — region: eu-west-1 — alert_id: alert-98765

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident created: PD-22456 — escalation policy: edge-ops — paging emily (oncall)

Emily (oncall): ack'd. I'm on it, pulling logs and checking health dashboards. ETA 2m.

Sarah (sre): seeing a spike in TLS 526 / handshake failures from healthcheck probes and customer requests. Error in edge logs: `tls: handshake failure (sni mismatch)` — samples: `handshake_err_count: 3145 in 5m`

Raj (network): also seeing LB target health flapping in eu-west-1, a subset of backend pods are reporting 502/timeout. Could be recent cert or ALB config change. Querying target-group state.

Emily (oncall): running quick curl to simulate client:```bash
curl -v https://prod.redwood.example.com/ -H 'Host: prod.redwood.example.com'
* Trying 3.10.22.45...
* Connected to prod.redwood.example.com (3.10.22.45) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.2 connection using ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
* TLS handshake error: SSL: certificate verify failed (protocol error)
* Closing connection 0
```

Mike (support): multiple customers in EU reporting failed requests and errors in-app; some see 502s, others See TLS errors. CS triage page: https://redwood.internal/cs/incidents/PD-22456 (customers affected: ~12 accounts, mostly EU region)

Emily (oncall): initial hypothesis: cert rotation + ALB SNI routing misconfiguration or cached DNS pointing to old edge nodes. Checking recent deploys: `git log --since "2h" --pretty=oneline` shows no app deploys to edge-proxy, but infra repo had a small cert rotation PR merged 18m ago by infra-bot.

Raj (network): confirming: AWS ALB listeners recently updated to add new cert arn: `arn:aws:acm:eu:123:cert/abcd-rotated` at 01:12Z. I see 50% of connections hitting nodes with new cert and others with the old cert — SNI negotiation sometimes fails when backend expects specific cert chain. Also seeing DNS TTL for edge domain still 300s; but we have some stale resolver caches in partner ISPs.

Sarah (sre): load-balancer target health:```json
{"targetGroupArn":"arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:eu-west-1:tg/edge-proxy-tg","healthy":41,"unhealthy":9,"unhealthy_reasons":["502","timeout","tls_handshake_error"]}```

Raj (network): mitigation options:
- immediate: shift traffic weights away from eu-west-1 to eu-central-1/primary for 10m (fast failover)
- rotate cert back to previous arn on ALB listeners (rollback)
- purge ISP-facing caches (limited) + reduce DNS TTL to 60s (but propagation will take at least current TTL)

Emily (oncall): I prefer weight-shift first to reduce customer impact while we validate certificate chain. Sarah, can you open a rollback PR ready if weight-shift doesn't stabilize?

Sarah (sre): on it. Creating runbook step and PR template. PR link: https://redwood.internal/infra/changes/rollback-cert-22456

CDN-Team-Bot: Notified CDN vendor (ticket #CDN-8891). Vendor acknowledges potential edge cert cache mismatch — investigating cached certs in front of CDN POPs.

Mike (support): CS posted triage note to impacted customers: short summary + mitigation in progress, ETA updates every 15m.

Emily (oncall): executing weight-shift command (testing with 20% initially):```bash
# shift 20% away from eu-west-1 to eu-central-1
redwood infra route shift --service edge-proxy --from eu-west-1 --to eu-central-1 --percent 20 --note "emergency shift PD-22456"
```

incident-bot: Action executed: traffic shift started — 20% moved off eu-west-1. Monitoring for error rate drop.

Sarah (sre): metrics update 3m after shift: TLS handshake error rate down 42% globally; eu-west-1 still elevated but customer errors decreased. Health count now: `healthy: 46, unhealthy: 4`.

Raj (network): continuing to gather ALB listener logs. Found inconsistent SNI header rewrite on a small subset of proxy rules applied by infra PR 1029. Reproduced locally with config diff:```diff
-  listener_rule: host-header=*.redwood.example.com -> cert=old-cert
+  listener_rule: host-header=*.redwood.example.com -> cert=new-cert
```
Some legacy routes still reference `old-cert` in TLSPolicy leading to handshake mismatch when upstream expects new chain.

Emily (oncall): good catch. Two parallel actions: keep incremental weight-shift to stabilize traffic, and Sarah prepares cert-rollback PR as standby. If errors persist beyond 15m we rollback.

pagerduty: Escalation notice: no ack from senior oncall in 10m — escalating to senior network (raj).

Raj (network): acknowledging escalation, standing by to coordinate with infra/PKI if rollback needed.

CDN-Team-Bot: CDN vendor suggests a partial purge for affected POPs and confirms they can clear cached certs within ~8 minutes for the listed POPs. Vendor action started. Ticket: https://vendor.cdn/ticket/CDN-8891

Emily (oncall): metrics 12m after start: customer error pages down ~70%, impacted customer count reduced to 3 accounts with intermittent errors. Proceeding to gradually restore weights if stable. Setting incident severity to P1 but moving into mitigation -> monitoring phase.

Sarah (sre): Opening postmortem stub and assigning owners. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-tls-handshake

Mike (support): continuing customer comms. Notifying affected customers with ETA 30m for full stabilization.

Emily (oncall): handing off to Raj for deeper infra root cause and rollback authority. I'll remain available for customer comms for next hour. Handoff note: "traffic shifted, CDN purge in progress, RM to validate ALB listener rules + reconcile cert mappings."

Raj (network): taking over — will validate all ALB listeners and coordinate rollback if CDN purge + weight-shift don't reach full recovery. If we rollback, I'll coordinate a short maintenance window and notify CS before action.

incident-bot: PD-22456 status updated: acknowledged -> mitigated -> monitoring. If error rate rises above threshold for 5m, auto-escalate to PD-Lead.

Emily (oncall): adding brief timeline to thread for PMs and ops:
- 6865432100 root alert fired (handshake surge)
- 6865432115 emily ack + initial curl
- 6865432130 weight-shift started (20%)
- 6865432180 metrics stable -> increased to 40% shift, vendor purge started
- 6865432250 impacted customers down from 12 -> 3

Raj (network): will update by EOD with root cause and remediation PR link. If anyone sees regression ping me @raj. :white_check_mark:
